_about: The seven CX designer Data requests. scripts/build_cx_guide.py writes acxd/disputes-assistant.md Part 2c and Part 3b step 7 from this file. Edit here, then run it.

inputHints.transactionId: The transactionId of the payment the customer chose, from listCardsAndPayments. Its number (for example 3) also works.
inputHints.disputeType: unauthorised if the customer did not make or does not recognise the payment; merchant if they made it but something went wrong.
inputHints.reasonCode: One of reasonsAllowed from the last dispute reply, matching what the customer said.
inputHints.cardInPossession: yes or no: does the customer still have the card?
inputHints.cardBlocked: yes or no: is the card blocked?
inputHints.contactedMerchant: yes or no: has the customer contacted the retailer?
inputHints.narrative: What happened, in the customer's own words.
inputHints.cardType: debit or credit: which card. Leave empty for both.
inputHints.page: Which page of five payments: 1 for the newest, then 2, 3 and so on when the customer asks for older ones.
inputHints.fromDate: Start of the period the customer gave, as YYYY-MM-DD, worked out from today in the last reply. Empty if they gave none.
inputHints.toDate: End of the period the customer gave, as YYYY-MM-DD. Empty if they gave none.
inputHints.orderReplacement: yes if the customer also wants a new card sent, no if not.

dataRequests.name: listCardsAndPayments
dataRequests.purpose: looks up the customer's cards and one page of their recent payments
dataRequests.description: Customer's cards and one page of 5 card payments, newest first, numbered. page 1 is newest; 2, 3 are older. Optional fromDate/toDate (YYYY-MM-DD) and cardType. Show the list to the customer.

dataRequests.name: startDispute
dataRequests.purpose: starts the dispute for the payment the customer chose
dataRequests.description: Starts the dispute for the chosen payment. transactionId: its ID or its number from listCardsAndPayments. disputeType: unauthorised (not made or not recognised) or merchant (made, but went wrong).

response.missing: Reason, Customer still has the card, In the customer's words

dataRequests.name: updateDispute
dataRequests.purpose: saves the customer's answers on the dispute
dataRequests.description: Saves the customer's answers. Send only fields you have. reasonCode: one of reasonsAllowed. cardInPossession, cardBlocked, contactedMerchant: yes or no. narrative: their own words.

request.narrative: I have never ordered from Amazon.

response.missing: Reason, Customer still has the card, In the customer's words

dataRequests.name: getDispute
dataRequests.purpose: reads the dispute back, including anything the customer typed on the form
dataRequests.description: The dispute as it stands, including anything the customer typed on the form themselves. Leave disputeId empty for the customer's latest open dispute.

response.missing: Reason, Customer still has the card, In the customer's words

dataRequests.name: blockCard
dataRequests.purpose: blocks a card and, if the customer wants, orders its replacement in the same call
dataRequests.description: Blocks the customer's debit or credit card at once. orderReplacement yes also orders a new card. Only after the customer agrees. Then say the confirmation from the reply, word for word.

response.confirmation: Your debit card ending 4821 is now blocked, so it can't be used again. Your reference is BLOCK-4821-ABC234. A replacement debit card is on its way and should arrive in 3 to 5 working days. Its reference is REPL-4821-XYZ789.

dataRequests.name: orderReplacementCard
dataRequests.purpose: orders a replacement for a blocked card
dataRequests.description: Orders a replacement for a card already blocked (cardType), when blockCard did not. Only after the customer agrees. Then say the confirmation from the reply, word for word.

response.confirmation: A replacement debit card is on its way and should arrive in 3 to 5 working days. Its reference is REPL-4821-ABC234.

dataRequests.name: sendFormLink
dataRequests.purpose: texts the form (phone) or gives a link to post (chat)
dataRequests.description: Shares the dispute form, joined to this conversation, when the customer wants it. Phone: it is texted; say only sentTo. Chat: post the link from the reply exactly as given.
